no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was conducted for this application. The Applicant and FDA had previously reached agreement on the key design elements of the pivotal efficacy studies. During review of the application, no concerns arose regarding the validity or clinical meaningfulness of the weight-loss results, and the review identified no new safety issues that might impact the benefit-risk consideration requiring Advisory Committee input.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for IMCIVREE (setmelanotide, NDA213793). The Summary Review states an AC was not needed because FDA and the applicant had previously agreed on the pivotal trial design, and the review found no concerns about the efficacy results or new safety issues affecting benefit-risk. The Medical Review's Advisory Committee section likewise records 'N/A,' so there is no AdComm influence to link to any approval decision.
